title: "THE HOI4 JOHN COLLECTION"
paragraph_01: The HOI4 JOHN Collection is a collection 31 Mods for the game "Hearts of Iron 4" that I developed within a span of a year
paragraph_02: Developed in the bracket language used by Paradox games, it initially started as a few graphical mods but then gradually became more advanced mods adding functionalities to the game as time passed on
paragraph_03: The Most famous mod in the collection is the "Minimalistic Battle Plans" mod, that has over 1.000 Ratings, 50.000 subscribers and over 220,500 views on Steam!
paragraph_04: Other notable mods in the collection is the "OWB: Special Projects" mod, adding technologies to the Total overhaul mod "Old World Blues", and "Expanded Helicopter Technologies" that adds expanded technologies to Vanilla HOI4
paragraph_05: Throughout the mods development I learned a lot of coding with the Paradox Bracket language and further insight within game graphics. The collection also eventually led me to become a developer within the Total Conversation mod "Red Dusk"
